description: This file defines the LanguageAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing Language entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) of language records, validation rules, and API documentation annotations. It interacts with the LanguageService to perform operations and returns serialized models for API responses.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing Language entities, providing CRUD operations and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LanguageService instance, with lazy loading.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Language record by ID and returns it as a LanguageModel wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Language records with optional sorting and pagination, returning an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Language record based on request data and returns the created resource.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Populates a Language entity with data from request and saves it via the service.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Language record by ID with request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language records specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing records with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new Language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing Language record, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including string type, length, and uniqueness constraints.
